authorship.scope: Original foundation-first Burgers/Riemann/entropy, Godunov flux and MUSCL-limiter lectures and companions; preserve all 57 previous manuscripts and their individual metadata.

prerequisites.reason: Establishes characteristics, advection, and conservation for smooth transport.
Builds conservative finite-volume balance laws and shared face-flux bookkeeping.

background: Elementary single-variable calculus and algebra; prior characteristics, upwind CFL and finite-volume balances; no advanced nonlinear shock stability or functional analysis assumed.
readiness_checks: Derive characteristic positions and the smooth gradient from a decreasing linear initial profile.
Compute Rankine–Hugoniot speed for a Burgers shock.
Explain why weak conservation and entropy admissibility are separate requirements.

description: Uses inviscid Burgers characteristics to derive finite-time gradient blow-up with bounded states, then develops the weak conservation balance, shock speed, rarefaction fan and vanishing-viscosity entropy selection.
